criteria.title: Mobile sales representative UAT
criteria.closureCondition: Attach a dated, signed result from the agreed phones and tablets.

closureRecipe.session: One facilitated session against staging: 3 testers x 3 device classes (small phone, large phone, tablet) x 3 money-path journeys, ~half a day
closureRecipe.artifactConvention: docs/release-evidence/mobile-uat-<YYYY-MM-DD>/ folder — uat-summary.md (from MOBILE_UAT_RESULT_TEMPLATE.md), defects.csv, device-matrix.md, screenshots/, sign-off.md
steps: A2 done: staging live with backend sync enabled (VITE_WINGMAN_ENABLE_PROJECT_BACKEND_SYNC=true).
Run the session per the plan's script; scribe fills the result template and defect log live.
Create the dated evidence folder with all five files; the release owner signs sign-off.md.

Fill THIS row: artifactPath -> the folder's uat-summary.md, measuredAt -> session date, approver -> release owner, claimedStatus -> pass ONLY if all journeys passed unaided on all device classes with zero open blockers.
Run npm run generate:release-docs && npm run check:release-docs && npm run check:release-evidence.
closureRecipe.passRule: All journeys passed unaided on every device class; any 'partially' row, open blocker, or missing provenance keeps the criterion blocked. 90-day expiry applies from measuredAt.
closureRecipe.note: Real devices only — desktop browsers, mobile-width Playwright specs and axe runs are not UAT. Also does NOT close offline-reconnect-uat (Journey C step 3 is a smoke only).

criteria.title: Offline edit and reconnect UAT
criteria.closureCondition: Attach dated real-device evidence covering reconnect, duplicate update, and conflict resolution.

closureRecipe.plan: docs/OFFLINE_RECONNECT_UAT_PLAN.md (Drills A-D, expected behaviour from the code, session script)
closureRecipe.session: One facilitated session (~85 min script) against staging: airplane-mode edit/reconnect (A), duplicate update (B, real device + strict desktop replay), conflict banner resolution (C, both buttons), team-change conflict (D)
closureRecipe.artifactConvention: docs/release-evidence/offline-reconnect-uat-<YYYY-MM-DD>/ folder — uat-summary.md (from the plan's result template §9), defects.csv, device-matrix.md, screenshots/, sign-off.md
steps: A2 done: staging live with backend sync enabled and the app commit's service worker current.
Run the drills per the plan's script on the real-device matrix (small phone real airplane mode; tablet Wi-Fi toggle; desktop as reference only).
Create the dated evidence folder with all five files; the release owner signs sign-off.md.

Fill THIS row: artifactPath -> the folder's uat-summary.md, measuredAt -> session date, approver -> release owner, claimedStatus -> pass ONLY if Drills A/C/D passed on real devices, Drill B passed with its strict replay, and zero blockers are open.
Run npm run generate:release-docs && npm run check:release-docs && npm run check:release-evidence.
closureRecipe.passRule: Drills A/C/D on real devices + Drill B strict replay; any core-check failure, open blocker, or missing provenance keeps the criterion blocked. 90-day expiry applies from measuredAt.
closureRecipe.note: Automation (6/6 Chromium e2e, criterion offline-sync-resilience) is NOT human UAT - it complements this session. Real airplane mode is the honest offline; DevTools offline is a desktop reference leg only.

criteria.title: Production-like authenticated load
criteria.closureCondition: Attach authenticated staging measurements with p95, p99, and error rate.

steps: A2 done: staging exists and /api/wingman/health reports the expected storage mode.
Run the command above against staging (measure within 30 days of the launch date; the evidence expires 30 days after measuredAt).
On a strict-clean run the harness writes the dated artifact + sidecar and prints a paste-ready version of THIS row with metrics filled.
Set approver.name (reviewer of record), keep claimedStatus pass, replace this row, then run npm run generate:release-docs and npm run check:release-evidence.
closureRecipe.note: The printed template mirrors this recipe's shape (buildManifestRowTemplate); metrics are the worst case across budgeted scenarios, so the row can never claim better than any single scenario. A red run writes nothing.

criteria.title: Production journey observation window
criteria.closureCondition: Attach a dated operational export after a representative production observation window.

criteria.title: Governed-profile confirmation pass (human-verified technical data)
criteria.closureCondition: Attach a dated confirmation ledger: every governed technical profile human-verified with a named reviewer and confirmation date, zero awaiting or overdue, and the standing confirmation-aging, evidence-freshness, and evidence-liveness gates green.

criteria.title: Product-intelligence eager payload split (network waterfall audit)
criteria.closureCondition: Attach a dated network-waterfall audit of a production build showing the eager payload is the summary plus manifest, per-SKU detail loads only on open, and the retired monolith is absent from the build output.

criteria.title: Outbound fetch SSRF guard coverage (special-purpose IP classification)
criteria.closureCondition: Attach a dated audit showing every first-party outbound fetch path classifies its target against the special-purpose address registry, with the gap matrix pinned by the guard test suites.

criteria.title: Offline sync resilience (banner conflict resolution and revision trail)
criteria.closureCondition: Attach a dated critical-e2e run showing 409 conflicts resolve in-app through both banner paths and the revision trail stays one-per-edit; human device UAT remains a separate criterion.
